claims.label: Balanced passing and rushing
claims.text: Passing accounted for 57.65% of Denver Broncos's pass-and-rush attempts across 5 games in the 2026 regular sample (2026-09-10T00:20:00.000Z to 2026-10-13T20:37:26.384Z), and 52.94% of attempts faced by Seattle Seahawks across 5 games in the same window. Both pass shares are between forty and sixty percent. If these mixes continue, Denver Broncos could combine passing and rushing rather than lean heavily on one. This excludes sacks and does not establish tempo or yardage.
